citation.title: Fasting increases human skeletal muscle net phenylalanine release and this is associated with decreased mTOR signaling

population.description: Eight healthy men with no family history of diabetes, no prescription medicine; age 26±4 years and BMI 23.8±1.6 kg/m2 are printed without a label for the spread (the paper says results are means ± SE), so no SD is entered.

protocols.name: basal_control
protocols.description: Admission at 08:00 (t = 0) after a 10-hour overnight fast (control); serum sample at t = 30 min (Table 1 basal condition), 30 min into the non-nutritive amino-acid and urea tracer infusions (trace doses, not a meal). Arm ends after the sample: sample at minute 30, duration 31; start_hour 8.0 as printed, so the fast is 10.5 h at the sample while prefast_hours is the printed 10 h at admission.

protocols.name: basal_fast72
protocols.description: Admission at 08:00 (t = 0) after a 72-hour fast, tap water allowed (fasting); serum sample at t = 30 min (Table 1 basal condition), 30 min into the non-nutritive amino-acid and urea tracer infusions (trace doses, not a meal). Arm ends after the sample: sample at minute 30, duration 31; start_hour 8.0 as printed, so the fast is 72.5 h at the sample while prefast_hours is the printed 72 h at admission.

protocols.name: clamp_control
protocols.description: Admission 08:00 (t = 0) after an overnight fast of 10 hours (control); hyperinsulinemic euglycemic clamp t = 240-360 min (insulin 0.8 mU/(kg*min), glucose clamped at ~5 mM); sample at t = 270. The arm ends after the t = 270 sample (minute 270, duration 271). Clamp entered at the plasma levels Table 1 prints for t = 270: insulin 269.0 pM, glucose 4.9 mM. Amino acid tracer infusions t = 0-240 are not model inputs and are not entered.

protocols.name: clamp_fast72
protocols.description: Admission 08:00 (t = 0) after an 72-hour fast, tap water allowed (fasting); hyperinsulinemic euglycemic clamp t = 240-360 min (insulin 0.8 mU/(kg*min), glucose clamped at ~5 mM); sample at t = 270. The arm ends after the t = 270 sample (minute 270, duration 271). Clamp entered at the plasma levels Table 1 prints for t = 270: insulin 274.5 pM, glucose 4.6 mM. Amino acid tracer infusions t = 0-240 are not model inputs and are not entered.
